decision_rule: R3/R4 rules: a line is corrected if any fact is not on a stated row of that plant (or a company row worded company-wide), is placed at the wrong site, is misdated (board re-post stamp written as a posting date; aggregator or expired copy written as live; a date the row does not carry), is a plan written as progress or a superseded figure, uses a live count, leads with an older fact, lacks the closing 'you' question (opening lines), or the bottleneck guess is not hedged; a clause on the source page but on no row is corrected. Unreachable = a clause rests only on a source that cannot be reached (no live page, no archive). 'listed <date>' for board stamps and 'first listed <raw PostedDate>' for UKG raw dates are allowed (coordinator rule 2026-11-17). 'read November 2026' is allowed where the row's retrieved_date carries it.
scope: Every opening_line and bottleneck_guess in ledger/inbox/battery-lines-L1.json and battery-lines-L2.json: 24 plants, 48 lines; 45 text lines checked (40 on High/Medium plants, 5 on Low plants Enercon, Pritchard Brown, General Industries); 3 set to 'unknown' (EK Madison x2, General Industries bottleneck) counted separately.
error_rate_note: 0/45 = 0.0% corrected on all text lines; High/Medium 0/40 = 0.0%. 2 lines unreachable (both Freeman Abilene lines: their posting is gone). Not-confirmed rate incl. unreachable: 2/45 = 4.4% all, 2/40 = 5.0% High/Medium. Excluding unreachable from the denominator: 0/43 = 0.0%. Unknown lines (3) not in any denominator.
